purpose: Redesigned game-over plaque, requested 14.11.2026. Local HTML review only; Unity transfer awaits approval.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one finished 16:9 high-fidelity game-over dialog concept for the existing Russian atmospheric coastal photography game Маяк. Use the attached actual night-ocean screenshot as the EXACT background plate: preserve its composition, islands, ships and horizon, with a dark readability veil over it. The other reference is the approved settings UI: use its warm ivory typography, subtle muted orange focus accent and precise photographic corner marks, but create a compact centered game-over plaque, not a full-screen settings screen.
Composition: centered flat matte dark graphite-blue rectangular panel occupying about 42% screen width and 51% screen height, plenty of clear negative space around it. Sharp square corners, very subtle thin perimeter border and four tiny ivory camera-crop corners. Large confident clean Cyrillic humanist sans-serif title centered near the top: "Вахта окончена". Below, quiet muted grey text, exactly "Топливо кончилось. Маяк погас." Generous vertical space. Next a clearly designed two-column result row: "Счёт вахты" above large warm-ivory "480", and "Рекорд" above slightly smaller muted-ivory "1 260". Align both numeric baselines. Bottom two horizontally aligned crisp rectangular action buttons: primary muted warm-orange fill with dark text "Новый забег" and small outlined keycap "F1"; secondary transparent with thin ivory-grey border and text "В главное меню" and small outlined keycap "Esc". Beautiful balanced spacing, carefully typeset Cyrillic, perfectly readable, sober atmospheric shipped PC-game quality. No extra copy, no badges, no new-record banner, no added counters, no logo, no ornament, no glow, no rounded corners, no cards inside the panel, no icons, no gritty distressed textures, no gradient borders. No website framing, no browser chrome, no explanatory mockup labels. Whole composition visible.
